name: Box breathing
description: Inhale for 4 counts, hold for 4, exhale for 4, and hold for 4. Repeat four times.

name: One-page journaling
description: Write what you feel, what you need, and one small thing you can do next. No editing needed.

name: Gentle drawing
description: Draw slow lines or shapes for five minutes and notice the movement of your hand.

name: Grounding with music
description: Play one calming song and name five sounds, four sensations, and three things you can see.
